prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original game foliage texture for a lightweight real-time 3D racing circuit environment, one spruce bough cutout.
Primary request: create a single natural Norway spruce branch with many fine dark green needles and smaller irregular branching twigs, isolated on a genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha. Entire branch visible, no clipping. One tapered bough runs horizontally from its thin woody attachment on the left to its slender needle-covered tip on the right. Its dense but airy needle sprays extend above and below the main branch, widest near the left-middle, tapering organically toward the right. Useful holes of transparency between small twig clusters; fine realistic silhouette.
Composition: square 1024 by 1024 image, orthographic straight-on view of the flattened bough, branch occupies about 88 percent of width and 66 percent of height, centered with clear transparent margins. This will be reused on small branch planes, so no perspective, no depth-of-field blur, no ground, no pot, no trunk, no entire tree, no cast shadow.
Lighting: even neutral overcast illumination suitable for a diffuse color texture, restrained natural green with subtle grey-green needle highlights, visible brown woody structure only along the thin main stem, no strong directional light or baked dramatic shadows.
Constraints: original unbranded foliage, no text, no watermark, no checkerboard painted into the image, real transparent pixels around and between the needles.
description: Original generated diffuse foliage cutout; no external image, named artist, branded model or real circuit scenery used as a reference.
